title: Governed Intake Agent
summary: An intake agent that cannot skip a step, cannot see fields it should not, and cannot transfer before it has what it needs.
scenario: Intake that survives a risk review

evidence: folder exists in recipes/ with recipe.json only; NEEDS A REPO: a build must be a thing you run

OUT OF SCOPE 2026-08-25 (recipe waves): this is a build row, not a recipe. A build is a repository you run, so it needs a repo and a composes list verified against its code, not the recipe authoring protocol. Untouched by waves 3 to 5 deliberately.
